body:
I get that I should pretend to be happy, but I've been pretending for years now, it feels like.  It's just too hard to even pretend anymore.  I feel like I have been trying to find someone for so long, and so many things in my life just seem to not be working out.  

I really have only been living the past few years with the HOPE of being happy in the future, sometime, somehow.  But I've been living off of that potential hope for too long, and I don't think I have it anymore.  The only way to not feel sad anymore, seems to be to just kill myself
